name: 4-AcO-DPT
summary: Research chemical of tryptamine class. First noted being sold in 2012. There are conflicting reports on it's effects. The drug does not dissolve well in all solutions it was tested.
advisory: Avoid: This tryptamine may work differently than other tryptamines. Caution is recommended for all mixes with it.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: It has been sold as a designer drug. It has been identified in illicit products in Japan.
